import os


def first_quantity():
    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "data", "stock.csv")
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    return int(rows[0]["العدد"])

def paginate(items, page=1, size=None):
    size = size or DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
    start = (page - 1) * size
    return items[start:start + size]

import re


def is_valid_email(addr):
    pattern = r"^[A-Za-z0-9._%+]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    return re.match(pattern, addr) is not None
